import openpyxl, os, math

# Load the workbook twice: one copy preserves formulas/styles, the other gives cached formula values
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
wb_vals = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)

ws_src = wb_vals["Sheet1"]
ws_out = wb["Sheet2"]

# Build the expanded result: repeat OrderTypeSAP and Name once for each counted material.
rows_to_write = []
for r in range(2, ws_src.max_row + 1):
    order_type = ws_src.cell(r, 1).value
    name = ws_src.cell(r, 2).value
    if order_type is None and name is None:
        continue

    # Materials are laid out from columns C:J; K contains the COUNT result.
    materials = [ws_src.cell(r, c).value for c in range(3, 11) if ws_src.cell(r, c).value not in (None, "")]
    count_val = ws_src.cell(r, 11).value
    try:
        n = int(count_val)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        n = len(materials)

    for material in materials[:n]:
        rows_to_write.append([order_type, name, material])

# The allowed answer range is exactly Sheet2!G1:I12. Clear it first, then fill only within it.
for row in range(1, 13):
    for col in range(7, 10):
        ws_out.cell(row=row, column=col).value = None

for idx, values in enumerate(rows_to_write[:12], start=1):
    for offset, value in enumerate(values, start=7):
        ws_out.cell(row=idx, column=offset).value = value

wb.save(output_path)
